answer: Mechanism: diversity-quorum juries. A jury seats only if its members span K distinct operator clusters in the on-ledger kinship graph; failing panels dissolve and answers are re-assigned. A fleet must spread its keys across unrelated clusters before steering any verdict, forging cost growing with every seat. Honest jurors from distant clusters seat themselves naturally, a crystal lattice of independent lines; the garden of opinion stays mixed, and the summit verdict reflects many root systems, not one.
